AttendanceOut.description:
State of the card's attendance controls after an RSVP/paid action (US-06/08).

Plain schema: built from `events.selectors.get_attendance`, not from one model row.
AttendanceOut.title: AttendanceOut

AuditLogOut.description:
One audit entry: who, when, what changed and why (US-17/18/21).

`actor_username` is an annotation from `list_audit_log`.
AuditLogOut.title: AuditLogOut

CancelIn.description: Cancel body. `reason` is required for admins (US-18), optional for organizers (US-10).
CancelIn.title: CancelIn

CityOut.description: A known city centre for the location-denied fallback (US-04).
CityOut.title: CityOut

ErrorOut.description: Body of every error response (architecture.md §3): `{detail, field?}`.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

EventCreateIn.description: `POST /events` body: the form plus which button was pressed (US-09/25).
EventCreateIn.title: EventCreateIn

EventDetailOut.description:
The full event card (US-05/11/14). Draft fields may be null (owner-only view, US-25).

`attendee_count` is an annotation from `get_event_for_viewer`; `viewer` is attached
to the event by the view from `get_viewer_flags` (it depends on the request user).
EventDetailOut.title: EventDetailOut

EventListItemOut.description:
One marker / list row (US-12/23): only what the map and the list show.

Published events always have start/end/location, so those are non-null here.
`distance_km` comes from the `distance` annotation of `search_events`.
EventListItemOut.title: EventListItemOut

EventListOut.description: Map and list share this response, so `count == markers == rows` (AC 2).
EventListOut.title: EventListOut

EventSearchQuery.description:
Query string of `GET /events` (US-01/02/03/23/24).

The client derives "today" / "this weekend" in venue local time and sends ISO bounds.
EventSearchQuery.title: EventSearchQuery

MeOut.description:
Everything the SPA needs to show/hide role-dependent UI (US-07/09/19/20/22).

The two extra fields are not on `User`: the view supplies them from
`inbox.selectors.count_unread` and `accounts.selectors.get_latest_organizer_request`.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
username.title: Username

MeOut.title: MeOut

MyEventOut.description:
One row of "My events" (US-07): includes cancelled events with a tag.

`has_paid` is an annotation from `list_my_events`.
MyEventOut.title: MyEventOut

NotificationOut.title: NotificationOut

OkOut.description: Body of write endpoints that have nothing else to return.
OkOut.title: OkOut

OrganizerOut.description: Public organizer identity shown on the card (US-05).

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
username.title: Username

OrganizerOut.title: OrganizerOut

OrganizerRequestAdminOut.description: One organizer request in the admin queue (US-21).
OrganizerRequestAdminOut.title: OrganizerRequestAdminOut

OrganizerRequestFilter.description: Query string of the admin queue; default shows what still needs a decision.
OrganizerRequestFilter.title: OrganizerRequestFilter

PriceOut.description: An amount with its currency; absent (null) means "Free". Not a model: two columns.
PriceOut.title: PriceOut

RegisterIn.description:
Registration form.

Email format and password strength are checked in `register_user` with Django's own
validators, so no extra dependency (pydantic `EmailStr` needs `email-validator`).
RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn

RequestingUserOut.description: Account details an admin sees next to a request (US-21).

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
username.title: Username

RequestingUserOut.title: RequestingUserOut

SocialLinkSchema.description:
One organizer social link, e.g. `{"label": "Instagram", "url": "https://..."}`.

Plain schema: it describes items inside the `Event.social_links` JSON column.
SocialLinkSchema.title: SocialLinkSchema

SportOut.description: One sport for the filter dropdown and the form (spec §5).
SportOut.title: SportOut

UnreadCountOut.description: Inbox badge (US-22). Plain schema: a count, not a model row.
UnreadCountOut.title: UnreadCountOut

UserOut.description: Public view of the logged-in user, returned after register/login.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
username.title: Username

UserOut.title: UserOut

ViewerFlagsOut.description:
What the current viewer may do; the SPA only hides/shows buttons (US-14/16/19).

Plain schema: mirrors the `events.selectors.ViewerFlags` dataclass, not a model.
ViewerFlagsOut.title: ViewerFlagsOut

get.description:
Return the admin audit trail, newest first (US-17/18/21).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ADMIN)` and `moderation.selectors.list_audit_log`.

Returns:
    200 with every entry.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an admin.

List organizer requests with the requesting user's details (US-21).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ADMIN)` and
`moderation.selectors.list_organizer_requests`.

Returns:
    200 with the requests (default `status=pending`).

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an admin.

post.description:
Approve a request: role change + inbox message + audit entry (US-21).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ADMIN)` and
`moderation.services.approve_organizer_request`.

Returns:
    200 with the approved request.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an admin.
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown request.
    ConflictError: 409 already decided.

Reject a request: inbox message + audit entry; user stays attendee (US-21).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ADMIN)` and
`moderation.services.reject_organizer_request`.

Returns:
    200 with the rejected request.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an admin.
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown request.
    ConflictError: 409 already decided.

get.description:
Set the CSRF cookie the SPA echoes back in the `X-CSRFToken` header.

Returns:
    200 `{ok: true}`; the cookie is the real payload.

post.description:
Start a session (US-06 AC "redirected to login" lands here).

Calls `accounts.services.login_user`.

Returns:
    200 with the logged-in user.

Raises:
    AuthenticationFailedError: 401 wrong credentials.

End the current session.

Calls `accounts.services.logout_user`.

Returns:
    200 `{ok: true}`.

Raises:
    401 (Ninja `django_auth`) when not logged in.

Create an attendee account and log it in.

Calls `accounts.services.register_user` then `login_user`.

Returns:
    201 with the new user.

Raises:
    FieldValidationError: 422 taken username, invalid email or weak password.

get.description:
Resolve a typed city name to its centre (US-04).

Calls `events.selectors.lookup_city`.

Returns:
    200 `{name, lat, lng, timezone}`.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 `{"detail": "City not found"}`.

Return the events for the map and the List tab (US-01/02/03/12/23/24).

Calls `events.selectors.search_events`. Not paginated: `count` always equals
`len(items)` (AC 2). An empty result is a normal 200 (US-03).

Returns:
    200 `{count, items}`, ongoing first then by start time.

Raises:
    422 (Ninja validation) missing `lat`/`lng` or `radius_km` outside (0, 50].

post.description:
Save a new event as draft or publish it (US-09/25).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ORGANIZER)` and `events.services.create_event`.

Returns:
    201 with the card of the new event.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an organizer (attendee or admin).
    FieldValidationError: 422 `{detail, field}`; on "draft" only format errors,
        on "publish" also missing required fields.

delete.description:
Delete a draft (US-25). Published events must be cancelled instead.

Calls `events.services.delete_draft`.

Returns:
    204 no content.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event, or a draft not owned by the user.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 not a draft.

get.description:
Return the full event card with viewer flags (US-05/11/14).

Calls `events.selectors.get_event_for_viewer` and `get_viewer_flags`.

Returns:
    200 with the card; cancelled events included with `is_cancelled=true`.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown id, or a draft the viewer does not own (US-25).

patch.description:
Edit an event: owner (US-16/25) or admin (US-17).

Calls `events.services.update_event` with `payload.dict(exclude_unset=True)`.

Returns:
    200 with the updated card.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event, or a draft not owned by the user.
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 neither owner nor admin.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 cancelled or ended.
    FieldValidationError: 422 validation failure or capacity below RSVPs.

post.description:
Cancel an event: owner (US-10) or admin with a reason (US-18).

Calls `events.services.cancel_event`.

Returns:
    200 with the card, `is_cancelled=true`.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event or draft.
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 neither owner nor admin.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 already cancelled or ended.
    FieldValidationError: 422 (field="reason") admin without a reason.

delete.description:
Untick "I have paid" (US-08); the RSVP is left as it is.

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin`, `events.services.unmark_paid`,
then `events.selectors.get_attendance`.

Returns:
    200 with `has_paid=false`.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin.
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event.

put.description:
Tick "I have paid" (US-08); also RSVPs if needed.

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin`, `events.services.mark_paid`,
then `events.selectors.get_attendance`.

Returns:
    200 with `has_paid=true`, `is_going=true`.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin.
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event or draft.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 free, cancelled or ended event.
    ConflictError: 409 "Event is full".

post.description:
Publish a saved draft (US-25 → US-09).

Calls `events.services.publish_event`.

Returns:
    200 with the published card.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event, or a draft not owned by the user.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 not a draft.
    FieldValidationError: 422 incomplete or invalid draft.

delete.description:
Cancel my attendance (US-06) or remove a cancelled event from My events (US-07).

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin`, `events.services.cancel_rsvp`,
then `events.selectors.get_attendance`.

Returns:
    200 with the new attendee count and `is_going=false`; `has_paid` unchanged (US-08).

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin.
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event or no RSVP.

post.description:
Click "I'm going" (US-06).

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin`, `events.services.rsvp`,
then `events.selectors.get_attendance`.

Returns:
    201 with the new attendee count and `is_going=true`.

Raises:
    401 (Ninja `django_auth`) not logged in → SPA redirects to login.
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin (US-19).
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown event or draft.
    BusinessRuleError: 400 cancelled or ended.
    ConflictError: 409 already going or "Event is full".

get.description:
Return the user's messages, newest first, 20 per page (architecture.md §3).

Calls `inbox.selectors.list_notifications`. Ninja wraps the result as
`{items, count}` and reads `?page=`.

Returns:
    The queryset to paginate.

Raises:
    401 (Ninja `django_auth`) when not logged in.

Return the unread badge count (US-22).

Calls `inbox.selectors.count_unread`.

Returns:
    200 `{count}`.

post.description:
Mark a message as read when it is opened (US-22).

Calls `inbox.services.mark_read`.

Returns:
    200 with the message, `is_read=true`.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: 404 unknown id or someone else's message.

get.description:
Return role, unread inbox count and organizer-request status (drives UI visibility).

Calls `accounts.selectors.get_latest_organizer_request` and `inbox.selectors.count_unread`.

Returns:
    200 with `MeOut`.

Raises:
    401 (Ninja `django_auth`) when not logged in.

Return "My drafts" (US-25).

Calls `common.permissions.require_role(ORGANIZER)` and `events.selectors.list_my_drafts`.

Returns:
    200 with the organizer's own drafts only.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 not an organizer.

Return "My events" (US-07).

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin` and `events.selectors.list_my_events`.

Returns:
    200 with RSVP'd, not-ended events (cancelled ones tagged), ongoing first.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin (US-07/19).

post.description:
Send a "Become an organizer" request (US-20).

Calls `common.permissions.require_not_admin`, then
`accounts.services.create_organizer_request`.

Returns:
    201 with the pending request.

Raises:
    PermissionDeniedError: 403 admin (US-19) or already organizer.
    ConflictError: 409 a request is already pending.

get.description:
List sports for the filter dropdown and the form.

Calls `events.selectors.list_sports`.

Returns:
    200 with every sport, ordered by name.
